title: The Grey Muster Comes for Bromusk
premise: The Hollow Court has opened the old road-tunnel under the Peaks of Thuhold, and what walked out of it has gathered on the Teeth of Kaudru: the Grey Muster, the dead of every barrow in those hills, marching down through Bethorn Downs on Bromusk, the Raukausk Moot's port on the Fields of Karkmo. Bromusk has no wall worth the name and no idea what is coming. Ride north to Keskgag, the Red Hold, and its levy will march — late, but in force. Or take the road to Bromusk yourself: warn it and man its fences, or lead its people up onto the rises of Varrn Plain and let the town go. And there is the Bethorn bridge, where the Muster must cross: burn it under them and buy the town time, if you can reach it through their vanguard.

areas.name: Thaurd Flats
areas.brief: Dry river flats. A Choir singer runs past you shouting that the dead are out of Kaudru, bound for Bromusk — and three of them are already on your trail.

say.line: The barrows on Kaudru are empty! They're walking on Bromusk!
Grey shapes on the river path behind you. They've seen you.

areas.name: Keskgag, the Red Hold
areas.brief: The Moot's great port on Vaubram Downs. Its hall keeps the levy of the north road; carry the word up the hill before the reeve shuts the doors for the night.

say.line: Keskgag's red gate. The hall is at the top of the hill — and the reeve doesn't wait for strangers.
Twelve spears for Bromusk. They'll march, but they won't run. Take something to bring them faster.

areas.name: The Herd Flats landing
areas.brief: A Salt Fleet barge tied up on the Herd Flats river, its crew salvaging what the herders left when they ran. They'll trade — briefly, and for whatever you have.

say.line: "You're running toward it? Mad. Here — take something, and be quick, we're casting off."

areas.name: The Varrn road
areas.brief: The straight road to Bromusk over Varrn Plain. The Muster's outriders have gone ahead of it and lie in the ditches.

say.line: The ditches by the Varrn road stir. They were waiting for whoever ran to warn the town.

areas.name: The Bethorn bridge
areas.brief: The timber bridge on the Motharn road where it crosses the Bethorn water. The Muster's vanguard is already on the near bank; its main body is coming down off Kaudru behind.

say.line: The bridge. Pitch on the beams, a torch in your hand — and the vanguard between you and it.

areas.name: Bromusk
areas.brief: A timber port on the Fields of Karkmo, its granaries full from the harvest; fences, not walls. The Muster comes over the Bethorn side.

say.line: Grey on the Bethorn road. Here they come.

choices.text: Ride north to Keskgag, the Red Hold, for its levy (late, but in force)
Take the river road by Herd Flats, where a Salt Fleet barge trades (a little slower)
Run the straight road over Varrn Plain to Bromusk
Ride ahead of the levy and tell Bromusk help is coming
On to Bromusk by the Varrn road
Cut east to the Bethorn bridge and burn it under the Muster
Warn Bromusk and man its fences
Warn Bromusk and lead its people up onto the Varrn rises; let the town go
Fire the bridge and race the smoke back to Bromusk

items.name: The Red Horn of Keskgag
items.text: Blow it and four of the Keskgag levy run ahead to you (twice) — but it fills your hand

items.name: A Keskgag courser
items.text: A post-horse from the hold's stable: the roads take 40% less time and the dead close slower — you reach Bromusk sooner, alone

items.name: A drowned ship's bell
items.text: Ring it: the dead within 45 cells turn to it for 30 s (twice). Ring it away from the houses

items.name: Salt-soaked sailcloth cloak
items.text: No fire takes within 25 cells of you: stand by the granaries and they won't burn

items.name: A Fleet boarding shield
items.text: Half the harm comes through — but it's huge: it fills your hand and your back

saved.text: Bromusk stands. The Grey Muster broke on its fences, and the Karkmo fields are full of the dead lying down again.

burned.text: Bromusk burned with its harvest in it. The Muster walks the ashes, and Kaudru's barrows have new tenants.

evacuated.text: Bromusk's people live, camped on the Varrn rises under the Choir's eyes; the town is ash behind them.

fell.text: The hero fell on the road. No one warned Bromusk; the Muster found it asleep, and spread on over Varrn Plain.
